FN-4AFB3I-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 85
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 05/03/2023
Senate Bill 85 as introduced provides for a 2% salary increase for public education employees
of the several local boards of education, the Alabama Institute for Deaf and Blind (AIDB), the
Department of Youth Services School District (except employees covered under the state's merit
system), the Alabama School of Fine Arts, the Alabama High School of Mathematics and
Science, the Alabama School of Cyber Technology and Engineering and the two-year
postsecondary institutions under the Board of Trustees of the Alabama Community College
System for the fiscal year beginning October 1, 2023. The total estimated cost of this salary
increase is $98.5 million, including the associated retirement and FICA expenses, for the fiscal
year ending September 30, 2024 and each year thereafter.
In addition, the act will increase the obligations of the funds of the various local boards of
education for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2024 and each year thereafter by
undetermined amounts dependent upon the extent that local boards of education have employees
paid from federal or local funds or provide a pay raise on salary supplements.
